operating_income.source: not found: operating_income is null in deskstack XBRL data for FY2023-FY2025 (verify_value also not_found); not filled from memory

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 revenue fell 1.6% and FY2023-25 CAGR was 2.5% (key_metrics); expect flat-to-down near term from patent expiries, then low-single-digit recovery from pipeline/acquired products.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: EBIT not reported in data; proxy (pretax income + interest expense)/revenue = 16.3% FY2025 (7,520+2,671)/62,579, 17.5% FY2024 (8,023+3,091)/63,627 from financial_statements; FY2023 5.5% depressed by one-offs. Used 17%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: no reliable effective rate in data (FY2025 tax proxy ~0); Damodaran pharma effective rate 3% looks too low for steady state; 15% reflects Pillar-Two global minimum tax and mix of US/foreign income.

wacc.source: CAPM: rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 1.02 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 9.4% Ke; beta = Damodaran pharma cash-corrected unlevered 0.915 relevered at D/E 0.145 and 21% tax; pre-tax Kd 6.02% (Damodaran) -> 4.76% after tax; weights 87.3/12.7 -> ~8.2%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and long-run nominal US GDP; conservative for a mature pharma with patent cliff.

net_debt.source: financial_statements PFE derived net_debt FY2025 = total debt 64,795 - cash 1,142 - short-term investments 9,183 (accession 0000078003-26-000026)
